title: Every endpoint has at least one role binding
statement: For any repo whose inventory_api sensor reading is non-empty and whose inventory_rbac sensor reading discovers ≥1 role table, every endpoint id in api-map.endpoints[] MUST appear in at least one of rbac-inventory.bindings.endpointBindings[] OR carry an explicit auth.required=false claim in the api-map endpoint. The default policy is deny: an endpoint with no role binding and no explicit public declaration is a discovery gap, not an implicit grant.
rationale: Per D-57's brownfield-adoption argument: adopting DEVAI on a pre-existing repo means inheriting a security posture that has accumulated without explicit role mapping discipline. INV-INVENTORY-003 surfaces every endpoint whose authorization story is undocumented. The 'gate' severity (Phase 10.A) reflects that an unbound endpoint may be legitimately public (e.g. /health, /metrics) — closure requires either binding a role to it OR explicitly tagging it as public. Either choice is acceptable; ambiguity is not.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
